# MachForge

> MachForge is an engineering-led CNC machining and prototyping studio in Shenzhen, providing DFM review and low-volume production support for robotics, UAV, and hardware teams.

MachForge coordinates CNC manufacturing for metal and plastic components from engineering prototypes to low-volume production through partner manufacturers in Shenzhen and the Pearl River Delta, China.

The focus is on manufacturability, DFM review, process and tolerance decisions, partner manufacturer coordination, quality control, production follow-up, and reducing manufacturing risk before production begins.

Services include:

- CNC milling and turning
- DFM review and manufacturability support
- CNC prototyping
- Low-volume production
- Partner manufacturer coordination and production follow-up
- Quality control and pre-shipment inspection
- Surface finishing

Typical manufacturing capabilities:

- 3-axis, 4-axis, and 5-axis CNC machining
- Prototype quantities from 1 piece
- Low-volume production
- Laser cutting and marking
- Surface treatments including anodizing, PVD, sandblasting, and electropolishing

Typical materials:

- Aluminum: 6061, 7075
- Stainless steel: 304, 316L
- Brass and copper
- Engineering plastics
- Titanium and other materials on request

Typical industries and use cases:

- Robotics
- UAVs
- Hardware products
- Engineering prototypes
- Low-volume hardware production
- Hardware startups needing CNC prototypes before production
- Engineering teams seeking DFM review before machining
- Robotics and UAV teams coordinating precision components in China

Location: Shenzhen, China — primarily supporting hardware teams in North America and Europe; projects from Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, and other international markets may be supported depending on project fit.

Contact: grant@machforge.xyz for technical inquiries and quotation requests.

## Primary Resources

- [MachForge website](https://www.machforge.xyz/): Official website for MachForge's CNC manufacturing coordination, DFM review, prototyping, and low-volume production services.
- [CNC Machining & Low-Volume Production](https://www.machforge.xyz/cnc-manufacturing-coordination/): Low-volume CNC machining and prototype runs, coordinated from CAD review to inspection and delivery through partner manufacturers in Shenzhen. MOQ 1 piece.
- [Engineering & CNC DFM Support](https://www.machforge.xyz/cnc-dfm/): Practical CNC DFM support for robotics, UAV, and hardware teams covering tool access, tolerances, materials, assembly, and production readiness.
- [Contact MachForge](https://www.machforge.xyz/contact/): Short inquiry form and direct email for CNC machining, prototyping and low-volume production requests.
- [316L O-Ring Groove DFM Case](https://www.machforge.xyz/case-studies/316l-o-ring-groove-dfm/): A DFM review of four 316L stainless parts that flagged an O-ring groove tolerance before the first prototype was cut.
- [6061 Stepped-Bore Holder DFM Case](https://www.machforge.xyz/case-studies/6061-stepped-bores-dfm/): A DFM review of a 6061 aluminum holder drawing raised five points before quoting, from ambiguous 0.25 callouts to Ra 1.6 finishing and stepped bores.
- [Grant Lv on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/grantlv-cnc/): Grant Lv's primary professional profile; founder of MachForge.
